Choose a photo and some styles, then press Stylize.

Style mixer — blend two paintings into a new style

Paintings use Magenta's arbitrary style transfer network (Ghiasi et al., 2017; TF.js port by Reiichiro Nakano, Apache-2.0), which can copy the style of any image. Classic styles are the PyTorch fast-neural-style networks (Johnson et al., 2016; BSD-3-Clause). All paintings are public domain, via Wikimedia Commons — see credits.
